product_description: USGS 1/3 arc-second elevation source tiles assembled into a county reference raster.

raster.vertical_datum_metadata_source: data/posey-county/README.md and source bundle records; not embedded as an explicit vertical CRS in the GeoTIFF
raster.elevation_units_metadata_source: data/posey-county/README.md and source bundle records; no explicit GeoTIFF vertical-unit tag
raster.nominal_ground_resolution_m: approximately 10 m; east-west ground spacing varies with latitude

reference_sample_at_candidate_parcel_cen.interpretation: Single-point numerical consistency check only. Difference is not an accuracy estimate, uncertainty interval, or evidence of survey-grade vertical agreement.

reproducibility_gaps: Individual source tile SHA-256 hashes were not recorded during assembly and are not asserted here.
The assembled raster does not internally encode vertical datum or elevation units; keep this provenance sidecar with the raster.
No parcel-scale bare-earth verification, breakline survey, or hydraulic terrain QA/QC is represented.
allowed_use: Regional context / screening reference only until a qualified engineer validates source lineage, CRS, vertical datum, units, resolution, void handling and fitness for the selected AOI.
disallowed_inference: Do not use the single point sample as parcel lowest adjacent grade, base flood elevation, channel bathymetry, or a hydraulic terrain surface.
